up: Retrieve activity_id, assay_chembl_id, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, standard_type, and molecule_chembl_id for activities where assay tid is 165 and standard_type is IC50.
sql:
SELECT
  a.activity_id,
  ass.chembl_id AS assay_chembl_id,
  a.standard_relation,
  a.standard_value,
  a.standard_units,
  a.standard_type,
  md.chembl_id AS molecule_chembl_id
FROM activities a
JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id
JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON a.molregno = md.molregno
WHERE ass.tid = 165
  AND a.standard_type = 'IC50';
